description: This file defines a class StreamLogger that implements logging to a PHP stream (such as stderr). It provides methods for warning and debug logs, managing stream resource ownership.

classes.name: StreamLogger
classes.description: A logger class that outputs log messages to a PHP stream, supporting warnings and debug messages. It manages stream resource cleanup based on constructor parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stream resource and indicates whether it should be closed upon object destruction.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that closes the stream resource if the closeOnDestruct flag is true.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message to the stream, optionally marking it as a deprecation warning.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message to the stream.
